svg.text: Real output captured from the session-lifecycle NixOS VM test (nix build .#e2e.session-lifecycle), 2026-10-16.
The test runs nails from the Nix store with an explicit --config, as root without sudo and with nobody logged
in: that is why binary-location warns and the inherited decoy state is not inspected. An operator runs sudo
